visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Utility comparison page: side-by-side property table. noindex — not an SEO surface. The landing state is the competitive surface: Redfin and Zillow open their compare screens on the visitor's own saved thumbnails, and this page has no saved-homes rail to open on. It wins instead by showing the finished object to a visitor who arrives with nothing — four real homes for sale right now, in the real table, labelled as an example, each one a single tap into their own comparison.
note: E-HOMES-SEARCH 2026-08-13. Migrated /compare chrome onto the v3 barrel. Chrome: layout mounts V3Chrome (sticky, in flow). This page does not remount it. V3Breadcrumb belowNav=false. V3Footer outside <main>. Page contract carried unchanged: robots noindex,follow, revalidate 60, canonical /compare, DAL fetch (getListingTiles by listNumbers AND listingKeys, dedup, getListingDetailPhotos), CompareClient props, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, V3SectionTracker pageType=compare. Shared /compare?ids= links keep resolving. Dual objectives unchanged. Capture does not live on this route. KB-era deletions: SmoothScrollProvider, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css, navy header band. AICompare deleted 2026-08-18 (never wired). MetadataBlock and KbSectionTracker stay on non-v3 registers. SITE-50 (2026-09-09): the empty state left V3Quiet for V3Slots, a new barrel pattern. The taste table scored this class 29 with the verdict 'an empty form label, not a product demo'; Quiet has no slot, no table and no figure by contract, so the fix could never be a prop on Quiet. Two more defects were fixed in the same change: the H1 sat in a bare <header> with no measure and no gutter and was clipped at x=0 at both 1440 and 375, and the visually-hidden spans inside the new table escaped their scroll container (no positioned ancestor) and made the document scroll sideways at 375 — html.scrollWidth 602 against a 375 viewport. SITE-95 (2026-09-15): the worked example moved off the hand-drawn table V3Slots used to carry and onto the installed catalog source. app/compare/_v3/CompareSheet.client.tsx imports @/components/ui/table (real data-slot rows, hover, data-state=selected) and @/components/ui/carousel (embla, one photo rail per home with the kit's own prev/next), painted navy/cream in app/compare/_v3/compare-sheet.css through v3 tokens only — the same shape app/invest/_v3/InvestTables.client.tsx uses. V3Slots keeps the pattern (headline, claim, visible SAMPLE label, tray, section 0 trace) and takes the sheet as a node; its own table, photo stamps, hairline bars and four outline Add buttons are deleted, not restyled. Rows went 8 to 9 (garage), every row carries a bar and the two extremes are marked on the field being read, the reading line over the sheet states that field's spread across all four homes, and at 375 a picker carries two homes at a time instead of cropping the second column through its own address. Photographs read through getListingPhotos, not getListingDetailPhotos: listing_photos held no row for any of the four newest active listings on 2026-09-15 (checked broad and by exact key), so the strip had nothing to page. SEO: ItemList JSON-LD naming the four sampled homes at their canonical listing URLs beside the BreadcrumbList, a description that names the fields, and the search door restored as a real anchor.

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts compare --builder claude-opus-5 --evaluator claude --url http://127.0.0.1:3296/compare — claude-sonnet-5 through the claude CLI, three scorings of the six shots below in one call, separate from the claude-opus-5 builder. No grok CLI exists in this cloud sandbox, so the judge is link 2 of the chain (site-queue SKILL.md, Matt 2026-09-15). Shots are of the PRODUCTION build (next build, then next start -p 3296).

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, http://127.0.0.1:3296/compare — the production build of this commit, served by next start. The open states are --states 'carousel-open=[data-compare-first] [data-slot="carousel-next"]@#compare-empty!click,table-open=[data-compare-row="Price / sq ft"]@#compare-empty!click'. The carousel click is scoped by data-compare-first so it can only land on the left-most rail, and that rail reads "2 of 5" with its second track mark filled while the other three read "1 of 5".

tasteReview.beats: No major portal (Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com) ships a public side-by-side compare-homes page with a per-figure freshness stamp — this page wins on that structural idea (the 'read Sep 15, re-read every 5 min' citation, highest/lowest bar callouts). It loses on execution: none of those portals' comparison grids look this flat, and this page doesn't out-craft even a basic spreadsheet.

defects.finding: carousel-open and the base shot are nearly identical — a bordered prev/next square and a '1 of 5' counter with no peek of the adjacent image, no drag affordance, no snap motion. This reads as a plain image-index toggle wearing arrow buttons, not the shadcn/embla carousel rail.

rows are flat gray zebra bands with a thin static bar per cell — correct data encoding but no header chrome, no hairline borders, no hover/row-highlight state visible; it reads as a stat strip, not an adapted table.

defects.section: SAMPLE SHOWS FOUR OF FOUR pill row (Barnes / Golf Village / Majestic / Henderson)
defects.finding: four identical flat navy rectangles with white caps text, no visible pressed/hover/selected differentiation across the shots — the generic 'flat V3Button navy rect' tell, not a distinct tag-select control.

defects.section: mobile pill panel, 'SAMPLE SHOWS TWO OF FOUR' block
defects.finding: at 375px the two selected pills (Barnes, Golf Village) sit above an orphaned full-width bordered 'Henderson' box that doesn't align to the same grid or button height — looks like a broken row, not a designed overflow state.

defects.section: page hero (eyebrow + Amboqia headline + one-line description)
defects.finding: identical formula to every other page on the site (small-caps eyebrow, oversized serif headline, gray description line, hairline) with nothing about this page — a comparison tool — expressed in the hero itself; no visual hint that four homes are about to be compared.

tasteReview.verdict: This is a correct, on-brand, honest page — sourced figures, an explicit 'SAMPLE' disclosure, highest/lowest bar encoding — that never becomes visually interesting: the carousel is a bare next/prev counter with no shadcn-style peek or drag (demoMatch false), the comparison sheet is a flat gray bar strip rather than a crafted table adaptation, and the mobile pill panel breaks its own grid. I can't confirm from screenshots alone whether SEO metadata or listing-fact depth rose versus HEAD — that needs the route's JSON-LD/title diff, not pixels — so treat that as unverified, not passing. Nothing here would make a visitor stop scrolling.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: All three instrument keys differ from the 2026-09-10 prior mark. evaluatorModel: claude-sonnet-5 through the claude CLI, because no grok CLI exists in this cloud sandbox (the prior mark was grok-4.6). rubricVersion: v1-2026-09-12, which added the blocking demoMatch rule and the replaceWith option list (prior was v1-2026-09-08). shotsHash: six new first-viewport shots off the PRODUCTION build, including the two open states this rubric requires. The 2026-09-12 taste table's row for this class (median 46, grok-4.6, v1-2026-09-12, demoMatch false) is a third instrument again. SAME-DAY DRIFT, STATED PLAINLY: the same judge on the same rubric marked this class 62 earlier today and 50 now, across six shots that differ by the slide counter, the drawn track, the picker's wording, the card body moving inside the rail and the prev/next moving off the photograph — every one of those a change this lane was asked to make, none of them a removal. Its three scorings this run were 47/52/50 and last run 58/62/65; the bands overlap. The lower mark is recorded as returned. WHAT THE JUDGE'S CAROUSEL AND TABLE FINDINGS ASSERT AND WHAT IS ON DISK: both catalog controls are installed and imported — app/compare/_v3/CompareSheet.client.tsx imports @/components/ui/table and @/components/ui/carousel directly, which ci:catalog-install and the Tip Ready route-import check both verify; the sheet renders the kit's own data-slot table with a header band of column names, row borders, hover and data-state=selected, and one embla rail per home with the kit's CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext, its API-example slide counter and a drawn track. The demo look an earlier run asked for — circular arrow buttons — is not reachable inside the brand lock: --v3-radius-control and --v3-radius-pill are 0 by token (CLAUDE.md section 3), and the accept order puts navy/cream/tokens above the score. None of this overrides the mark. contentFloor measured on this build at 1440 with the sandbox CA trusted: h1 1, words 335, headings 0, sections 2, internalLinks 168, images 20, heroImageWidth 245, heroImageNatural 1538, video 0, jsonLd 4 — every floor holds and jsonLd rose by the ItemList.
